title: Issue after the last update
content:
i updated my clo app to the latest version and then i had an issue that CLO 3D is open but stuck on a blank (black) interface — no workspace, avatar, or panels are showing properly. Can anyone help me solve this problem?![23693d7e0302450ea79a0a97795c59f6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/21a1b0a7fabf480197fe09787b228bb0/images/23693d7e0302450ea79a0a97795c59f6Screenshot%201446-12-26%20at%2012.37.54%E2%80%AFPM.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi! I had a similar issue after an update — here’s what helped:Try resetting the workspace: Main Menu > Display > Reset to Default Layout.Update your GPU driver — sometimes black screen happens because of driver conflicts.You can also try launching CLO in OpenGL mode instead of DirectX (or the other way around).Hope this fixes it! Let me know if it works. 😊

Comment 2: Hi There. First thing is to try the reset layout option. Bottom Right corner of the CLO screen.If the issue persists you will need to completely uninstall and reinstall CLO1) Please refer to the web document below to completely delete CLO and the files that make up CLO from your computer.https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/21a1b0a7fabf480197fe09787b228bb0 Download the latest installer from the CLO website and install it with administrator privileges. You can download the latest Installer here:https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/21a1b0a7fabf480197fe09787b228bb0
Reply 1: I've tried everything and avatars still aren't showing up for me. My menus aren't working properly no matter how many times I refresh my menu and I've reinstalled three times.
Reply 2: Hi again. We can make 2 additioinal suggestions1) Please check that you have given CLO full access. Article here - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/21a1b0a7fabf480197fe09787b228bb0 Update CLO. According to our records you are on 2025.0.148. But CLO has been updated several times. We recommend doing a fully uninstall as linked above and then installing a Newer Version of CLO. Newest version 2025.1.240If you are still having this same issue months later we would recommend reaching out directly to our Tech Support which we see you have done and we will let them know you have also posted here as well 🙂
content_description: This page aims to provide troubleshooting solutions for resolving the issue of CLO 3D opening to a blank black interface with missing workspace, avatar, and panels after an update.

title: Crochet Effect in CLO 🧶
content:
Want to recreate this cozy crochet flower texture in CLO? Here's how I did it using the **Knitwear material settings**!  
👇 These are the parameters I used:

🧵 **Stitching** : Stockinette  
🧶 **Yarn Thickness** : 7.00  
📏 **Gauge** : 2.20  
📍 **Generate Seams** : ON  
🔁 **Length** : 100 mm  
🌙 **Curvature** : 0.5  
✨ **Reflection Roughness** : 50

I also played with **Yarn Variance** and a soft **melange effect** to give it depth and realism. Perfect for playful and soft designs like this floral dress! 

Let me know if you try it!
